CommunityApplications.Profile:
Unraid templates for [wolffcatskyy](https://github.com/wolffcatskyy)'s CrowdSec tooling.
Currently shipping:
- **crowdsec-blocklist-import** - import 28+ public threat-intelligence blocklists into CrowdSec via LAPI, with deduplication, normalization, and automatic refreshes. Runs as a self-scheduling daemon, so no User Scripts cron job is needed.
Support: open an issue on the [source repository](https://github.com/wolffcatskyy/crowdsec-blocklist-import/issues).
